subject: Intro + brief demo request — ShopFlux PoC (self-serve sign-up)
messages:
From: Kai Huang <kai@shopflux.com>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: rebecca@shopflux.com
Date: 2027-05-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick intro & demo request — ShopFlux PoC

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the great product — I signed up via the self-serve flow earlier this week (trial tenant: shopflux-2027). We're evaluating Redwood to power an embeddings-based search layer for our product catalog (search + semantic recommendations). High-level:
- Expected QPS: ~1,200 avg, spikes to ~6,000/day (peak concurrency unknown yet)
- Typical request size: short queries (10-40 tokens) but we also have a subset of long context pass-throughs (~500 tokens)
- Timeline: want a PoC in Q3, production by Q4 if it meets latency/cost goals

We'd like a short demo to see: hosted vs dedicated tradeoffs, cost ballpark for that volume, and how the prefix/KV caching works for repeated queries. Attached is a 1-page PoC requirements doc that lists data sensitivity and a few questions on SSO.

Can we schedule a 30-minute demo next week? Rebecca (cc'd) will join from our infra team. We're in EST (UTC-4). Afternoons after 1pm our time are easiest.

Thanks,
Kai
Director of Engineering, ShopFlux
(p) +1 617-555-0143

Attachment: poc_requirements.pdf (1 page)
From: jasmine_liu@redwood.com
To: Kai Huang <kai@shopflux.com>
Cc: Rebecca Lin <rebecca@shopflux.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-03T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro & demo request — ShopFlux PoC

Hi Kai — welcome and thanks for the details, excited to help. A few quick qualification items so we can tailor the demo and pull the right folks: 

1) Use-case specifics: is the primary goal retrieval/semantic search (query->top-K) or more of a hybrid reranker + generation flow? Any examples of user journeys?
2) Data sensitivity: the doc says "PII in product metadata" — can you confirm if customer personal data will be sent to the API, or if all sensitive fields are stripped before indexing?
3) SLA/latency target: median p95 target per query (e.g., <=150ms p95) — what would be acceptable for your UX?
4) Traffic shape: is the 6,000/day a batch of spikes or sustained bursts across the day? Do you have estimates for concurrent requests during peaks?
5) Admin/security: do you need SSO (SAML/Okta) for the console and a private VPC/Private deployment eventually?

If you can reply with short answers we'll set up the right engineer for the demo. Tentative 30-min slots I can offer (all EDT):
- Tue 2027-05-11 2:00pm–2:30pm EDT
- Wed 2027-05-12 3:30pm–4:00pm EDT
- Thu 2027-05-13 1:00pm–1:30pm EDT

Or feel free to pick a time on my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/jasmine-30m

I'll loop in Ben from SDR to coordinate the calendar and Monica from Customer Success if the PoC looks like it'll need a dedicated sandbox.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Kai Huang <kai@shopflux.com>
Cc: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Rebecca Lin <rebecca@shopflux.com>
Date: 2027-05-04T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro & demo request — ShopFlux PoC

Hi Kai — Ben here (SDR). Thanks for the quick sign-up. Picking up to get this on the calendar — Jasmine proposed a few slots; if none work I can propose alternatives. A couple quick, pragmatic notes so the demo is productive: 
- If you can paste one sample query and one example of a long context item, we can pre-load a small demo index to make the session concrete.
- For SSO: do you already use Okta? We can walk through SAML setup during the follow-up.
- Do you want the demo to include cost modeling for hosted vs dedicated? I can bring our pricing estimator.

Proposing Tue 2027-05-11 2:00pm EDT to lock it tentatively — if that's likely to change, tell me a couple of dates that week that are open and I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Ben Carter
SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Kai Huang <kai@shopflux.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Rebecca Lin <rebecca@shopflux.com>
Date: 2027-05-05T11:22:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Quick intro & demo request — ShopFlux PoC

Hi Ben/Jasmine — thanks. A quick update: the lead engineer who needs to join is out the week of 5/11. Can we move to the following week (week of 5/18)? Our preferred windows are 1:00–4:30pm EDT any day except Friday.

Answers to the quick questions:
- Primary flow: retrieval -> lightweight rerank (no generation in the PoC)
- PII: we redact customer emails and phone numbers before indexing; product metadata has vendor contact names (not customers) — we'll mark them as non-sensitive for the PoC
- Latency: trying to target <=200ms p95, tolerate up to 300ms during peak bursts
- Traffic shape: daily bursts — typical day 1,200 QPS distributed, peaks concentrated in 2–3 hour windows with ~150–300 concurrent requests
- Yes, we use Okta and want SSO for the console — private deployment not required for PoC but may be for prod

We can share a small sample dataset ahead of the call. Can you propose 2–3 times week of 5/18 in EDT?

Thanks,
Kai
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

If helpful, I can do a 15-minute sync with Rebecca before the demo to confirm Okta metadata and a sample dataset upload.

Links: pre-demo checklist (stub) -> https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-poc-docs

Monica Patel
